checks: TIM6 is configured for 10 ms interrupts at 160 MHz
PC13 EXTI detects both press and release edges
USART1 is configured for 115200 baud, transmit only
GPDMA channel 0 uses USART1_TX request and linked HAL handles
Before 1000 ms there is no LED transition or UART report
LED changes inside TIM6 IRQ at 1000 ms without polling
The first periodic DMA message reports interval, full cycle and press count
Real HAL DMA points from the static SRAM message to USART1 TDR
Polling cannot overwrite or restart an active DMA message
DMA completion retains the buffer until the final UART TC interrupt
USART1 TC releases the buffer and counts one completed message
Contact bounce does not change speed before a stable 40 ms press

Entering OFF switches off an already lit physical LED immediately
OFF remains dark through 300 timer interrupts without main-loop polling
Holding the button in OFF counts only one press
Release bounce cannot produce another press
Next press selects mode index 2
LED waits the full 100 ms interval
TIM6 produces the 100 ms interval
Next press selects mode index 3
LED waits the full 250 ms interval
TIM6 produces the 250 ms interval
Next press selects mode index 4
LED waits the full 500 ms interval
TIM6 produces the 500 ms interval
Next press selects mode index 0
LED waits the full 1000 ms interval
TIM6 produces the 1000 ms interval
Slowing through all four blink intervals wraps back to sustained OFF
Delayed polling sends one current snapshot with six presses and TX completion count
UART DMA keeps reporting in OFF and distinguishes disabled mode from a blink off-phase
Normal polling schedules exactly one DMA report per second
A missing UART completion aborts safely after 250 ms
UART reporting resumes after a timed out transfer
A real DMA error IRQ releases ownership through main-loop recovery
An immediate DMA start failure is counted and recovered
Successful DMA/UART transmission resumes after both error paths
Button debounce works across the HAL tick rollover and re-enables blinking from OFF
Leaving OFF waits the full new interval before lighting the LED

scope: Real compiled ARM demo and EXTI/TIM6/GPDMA/UART HAL IRQ paths. MMIO, DMA data movement, TX acknowledgement and DMA abort suspension are simulated; no physical board timing or UART wire data is measured.
